note: What each exhibit captures, and out of which commit. bin/freeze-exhibit.mjs reads this and never touches the source repositories' working trees — it only runs `git show`.

exhibits.defectClass: A public promise of a grade band the scoring engine never issued
exhibits.whyThisCommit: The parent of the fix. At this commit GRADE_FLOORS holds exactly four grades (A, B, C+, C) and gradeForScore returns null below 200, while twelve public surfaces — including src/app/layout.tsx, the site metadata on every page — promise 'an A-E grade per sub-test'. There is no D and no E in the engine.
exhibits.provenAt: Both halves are in this one commit: the engine in src/lib/oet/scale.ts and the promises in the eight app files below. No build and no database is needed to decide it.

exhibits.defectClass: A sitemap URL that 404s, redirects, or is non-indexable
exhibits.whyThisCommit: AlmiOET has never carried this defect — see A2_CASE_STUDY_CORPUS_CANDIDATES.md for the seven checks. At this commit next.config.ts declares nine /guides -> /learn 301s on live indexed URLs, src/lib/learn/articles.ts builds every /learn route from content/learn/*.md, and content/learn/ holds exactly two scaffold files. All nine destinations were missing: 9 of 9 redirects landed on a 404.
exhibits.provenAt: The redirect table, the route builder and the directory listing are all at this one commit. The listing is the proof and it is captured as a listing because an absence has no bytes.

exhibits.defectClass: A rendered count that does not match the underlying data
exhibits.whyThisCommit: The parent of the fix. reading_c.ts holds 42 items, of which exactly six carry a prompt promising '(A, B or C)' — three options — while every one of their eight questions offers four. The same six the fix commit names.
exhibits.provenAt: Prompt and options sit in the same file, and the file that renders the prompt to the learner (session/[sessionId]/page.tsx line 231, prompt={current.item.prompt}) is captured beside it. No database is needed.

exhibits.defectClass: Present in the source but absent from the rendered HTML
exhibits.whyThisCommit: The parent of the fix. Turbopack — the default bundler for `next build` in Next 16 — trims the leading space of a multi-line JSX text node that follows an element, so ` del nostro` ships as `del nostro`. esbuild and SWC both keep it.
exhibits.provenAt: 🔴 NOT PROVABLE FROM SOURCE, AND THAT IS THE DEFECT CLASS. The source at this commit is innocent — the space is there. The rendered artefact carries the defect, and the single-line control in the same build proves the cause is the LINE BREAK, not the words.

toolchain.bundler: Turbopack (the default for `next build` in Next 16)
toolchain.why: Without this exact bundler the defect does not exist. A build with esbuild or SWC keeps the space and the exhibit disappears.

exhibits.artefactNote: BOTH sides are captured: the source out of the commit, and the RENDERED HTML from a build with the pinned toolchain. See rendered/HOW_IT_WAS_CAPTURED.md for exactly what was built and how it differs from a full product build.
exhibits.capturedHow: next build (Turbopack) at Next 16.2.12 / React 19.2.4 — the versions this commit pins — over the three JSX text nodes copied VERBATIM out of the commit, plus a single-line CONTROL of the same words.
